name: Sasaki Kojirou
source:
"Do you require my swordsmanship?"

Based on Sasaki Kojirou, who was a prominent Japanese swordsman widely considered a master of his craft, born in Fukui Prefecture. He lived during the Sengoku and early Edo periods and is most remembered for his death while battling Miyamoto Musashi in 1612.

Kojirou lives only to fight the strong and improve her swordsmanship. Having been stood up by Miyamoto Musashi for their duel at Ganryu Island, she joins the Zipang forces on the condition that they help her find her.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char01g]English official site[/url]]
